acceptance_gate_results.principle: Every upstream byte string must match its authenticated identity.
All 320 stored completion rows must rebuild exactly.
All 192 semantic rows must rebuild exactly.
Every malformed or mutated fixture must fail closed.
Unknown cause prevents readiness and fresh inference.
Every focused test, lint, replay, and artifact check must pass.

field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Declare models executable now; keep historical identities in hashed sidecars.
field_principles.acceptance_gate_results: Record expected, observed, passed, and principle for every criterion.
field_principles.comparator_contract_path: Hash the public decision schema and exact native request settings for the next canary.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure monotonic elapsed time and disjoint phase spans.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host orchestration is host; identify device work separately.
field_principles.field_principles: Store explanations here; consumer values remain ordinary top-level fields.
field_principles.first_divergence_rows: Locate producer and consumer mismatches without repairing historical replies.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: For blocked work name upstream, exact check, observed value, and expected value.
field_principles.historical_arm_reduction: Report each arm separately with all invalid and abstained outputs.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Completed findings start complete_; external absence starts blocked_.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Use the recognized literal for the actual computation.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the correct no-LLM class and never pad duration.
field_principles.invocation_counts: Separate attempted and completed loads and generation from usable answers.
field_principles.model_invoked: Derive this from current calls, including failed or unusable generation.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Record actual input hashes, authority separation, resource ownership, and failures.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze independent-unit seeds before observing results.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Bind code, configuration, manifests, and raw evidence.
field_principles.rows: Keep each unit, arm, seed, error, abstention, cost, metric, and censoring state.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260913 and actual UTC start and end times.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Record planned, attempted, completed, censored units, and stopping rule.
field_principles.schema: Version the result and retain ordinary top-level experiment_id and milestone.
field_principles.semantic_replay_ready_score: One means exact reconstruction and fail-closed malformed controls, without an accuracy threshold.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Preserve exact input identity, retirement, and quarantine status.
field_principles.status: Use complete or blocked for terminal evidence; keep unfinished work in separate checkpoints.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Retain command, exit code, timing, and log hash without hiding failures.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use the closed verdict class set; only unfinished current work is partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Expose shared evaluator authority; conformance is not learned correctness.

sample_size_budget.stopping_rule: replay all frozen calls once; no accuracy stop
